correctness.rationale: For G=Z/n, n≥2, a(x)=x+1 and b(x)=f(x) arbitrary, define Φ(K)={d:∀x, f(x+d)−f(x)∈K}. Φ maps subgroups to subgroups by telescoping and is monotone; H_0={0}, H_{t+1}=Φ(H_t) grows until fixed after ≤Ω(n) strict subgroup inclusions. Bob can translate a marked pair to any x with a-word, while Alice's a preserves d and b sends d to f(x+d)−f(x). Induction with arbitrary Bob prefixes proves two states force-merge in ≤t Alice moves iff d∈H_t, even with Bob first. Sequential pair merges reduce full image size (Bob words cannot expand image sets), so Alice wins iff H∞=G; if H∞ proper, Bob chooses a perpetual losing marked difference. Each step tests n² differences and ≤log₂ n strict stages. For n prime H1=G iff f constant. Composite nonconstant f periodic mod nontrivial divisor r with outputs in one residue mod r gives H2=G. At n=pq, subgroup lattice forces winning iff f factors mod p or q and values all lie in a single residue class for that divisor. Counts p(n/p)^p plus q(n/q)^q minus n intersection constants (one option if p=q), yielding p^{p+1}, or p q^p+q p^q−pq. Independently iterated all n^n maps for n=2..6, counts exactly 2,3,8,5,36, total 50,068 maps. Source's separate subset-game attractor method was inspected; finite counts support but do not replace all-n induction.

originality.rationale: Lipin–Volkov 2026 defines this unrestricted game and proves general relation/two-token recognition, which are clear prior stronger *decision* tools over arbitrary automata. Its inspected Section 3 does not give this cyclic map subgroup hierarchy, prime/composite dichotomy or exact semiprime labeled-function enumeration. The cycle arithmetic classification is a specialization with substantially more explicit structure. Ordinary circular automata synchronization is weaker than adversarial winning; earlier prime-order ordinary reset results do not imply this theorem. No demonstrated earlier formula dominates the counts; a specialization of the general relation operator could produce the subgroup criterion, and this derivability is acknowledged.
residual_risks: The H_t iteration may be a mechanically recognizable specialization of Lipin–Volkov relation iteration; the exact counting formula is the principal surviving new result.
A semiprime enumeration may exist in unindexed automata enumerations or electronic tables.
Full-state and pair-game quantifiers require arbitrary finite Bob words; if game convention disallows initial Bob word, the proof provides a stronger pair statement under its stated convention.
